Bob Sheppard and Michael Patrick Carroll are also affiliated with the Religious Society of Friends. Henri de Lubac and Peter the Venerable are affiliated with the Religious Society of Friends. Giordano Bruno is affiliated with the religion of Religious Society of Friends.
